title: Unity MCP + Fable + Opus + Sonnet - Testing if it's worth doing a Voxel game
author: donkeykong917
selftext:
This was definitely not one a shot. Progressive fine tuning and I think I go it a ok state voxel world generator.

* Using it's Unity 3rd person multiplater shooter demo as a template
* Using Unity MCP + Fable to do most of it with smaller tasks left to Sonnet.
* Building a voxel world generator and put the character inside for some shooting destruction fun.

Once I get the basics down, let the creative fun begin of a game...

Any improvements you reckon?

comments.author: bettertagsweretaken
comments.body: What's the game idea behind needing a fully destructible environment in an fps?

replies.author: donkeykong917
replies.body:
Sandbox test for now. I'll use the voxel engine a bit later for something else.

Realistically, unless it's artillery, tanks, canons, lasers, bombs, bazookas etc. It's not worth going for a destructive world. 

Even pill boxes in WW2 were like indestructible coz they had like 1m to 3m+ concrete. Bomb proof.

So you are right, for a fps. It ain't worth it.
